# Austin Air Systems

> > Medical-grade air purification systems engineered for clinical respiratory health, allergen removal, and mold solutions.

Austin Air Systems manufactures HEPA-based air purifiers designed with clinical efficacy for asthma relief, allergy management, and indoor air quality improvement. The company offers customizable product bundles and educational resources including the National Mold Solutions Summit for families and healthcare clinicians.

## Key Topics

- HEPA Filtration
- Medical-Grade Air Purifiers
- Asthma Relief
- Mold Solutions
- Air Quality
- Clinical Proof
- Handcrafted Manufacturing
- Allergy Relief
- VOC Removal
- Warranty Guarantee
- HSA/FSA Eligible
- Portable Air Purification
- Carbon Filtration
- Respiratory Health
- Indoor Air Quality

## Flagship Products

- [Immunity Machine](https://austinairsystems.com/products/immunity-machine): Immunity Machine 8-phase medical-grade air purifier product page with pricing
- [HealthMate](https://austinairsystems.com/products/healthmate): HealthMate clinically proven asthma air purifier with HEPA filtration technology
- [HealthMate Plus](https://austinairsystems.com/products/healthmate-plus): HealthMate Plus air purifier for chemical, smoke, and VOC removal with carbon filtration
- [Bedroom Machine](https://austinairsystems.com/products/the-bedroom-machine): Bedroom Machine compact air purifier for nighttime respiratory support and allergies

## Compact & Portable Solutions
